newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning sets Egyptian pipe venture.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning sets Egyptian pipe venture.

text.p: Owens Corning said Thursday it established a venture for large-diameter, glass-reinforced plastic pipe in Egypt, the company's second partnership for pipe in the region.

Owens Corning's partners in the new venture, named Owens Corning Pipe Misr, are the Amiantit Group, a Saudi Arabia-based manufacturing concern, and the Artoc Group for Investment & Development, an Egypt-based manufacturing, marketing and engineering group.
The three partners will invest $11 million, with Owens Corning having the undisclosed largest stake, it said.
The operation will be managed through Owens Corning's Engineered Pipe Systems, the business segment responsible for developing the company's global pipe business.
Owens Corning Pipe Misr will build a manufacturing facility next year in Sixth of October City, an industrial area west of Cairo.

The plant will be equipped initially with machinery capable of producing pipes with diameters ranging from 300 to 1400 millimeters. Plans call for later increasing the plant's capability to 2400 millimeters.
